name: Land of the Giants
description: Set fifteen years in the then-future year 1983, the series tells the tale of the crew and passengers of a sub-orbital transport ship named Spindrift. In the pilot episode, the Spindrift is en route from Los Angeles to London, on an ultra-fast sub-orbital flight. Just beyond Earth's boundary with space, the Spindrift encounters a magnetic space storm, and is dragged through a space warp to a mysterious planet where everything is twelve times larger than on Earth, whose inhabitants the Earthlings nickname "the Giants". The Spindrift crash-lands, and the damage renders it inoperable.

videos.title: The Crash
videos.overview: The Spindrift crashes on the Land of the Giants and its crew and passengers quickly find themselves in a struggle for survival.

videos.title: Ghost Town
videos.overview: The Earthlings find themselves trapped in an Earth-sized town run by a giant eccentric and his sadistic daughter.

videos.title: Framed
videos.overview: When a giant hobo is framed for murder, the Earthlings come to his aid.

videos.title: Underground
videos.overview: The Earthlings become involved in an underground resistance in the giant civilization.

videos.title: Terror-Go-Round
videos.overview: Barry and Fitzhugh are captured by giant Gypsies.

videos.title: The Flight Plan
videos.overview: The Spindrift crew find an amnesiac Earthling, Joe, but it turns out to be a ploy by giant crooks to get hold of the ship's power supply.

videos.title: Manhunt
videos.overview: A giant escaping convict takes the Spindrift but then wanders into quicksand, endangering everyone.

videos.title: The Trap
videos.overview: The Earthlings try to salvage radium from a clock but find themselves at the mercy of giant scientists using a sound detector to home in on them.

videos.title: The Creed
videos.overview: Barry is strick by appendicitis and the Earthlings have no choice but to turn to a giant doctor for assistance.

videos.title: Double-Cross
videos.overview: An amnesiac Fitzhugh falls in with two giant thieves and becomes their willing accomplice.

videos.title: The Weird World
videos.overview: The Spindrift crew finds a paranoid survivor from Earth...but his suspicions endanger everyone.

videos.title: The Golden Cage
videos.overview: Mark falls for an attractive Earth girl - the survivor of a previous space flight.

videos.title: The Lost Ones
videos.overview: This time around, four punk kids from Earth run up against the Spindrift crew.

videos.title: Brainwash
videos.overview: The Giants have invented a chemical that forces those exposed to it to tell the truth, and plan to test it on the Earthlings.

videos.title: The Bounty Hunter
videos.overview: When the giants increase their search efforts, the Earthlings must increase their salvage efforts and end up captured by a giant and his daughter.

videos.title: On a Clear Night You Can See Earth
videos.overview: The Earthlings become involved with an insane giant scientist who has infra-red goggles he can use to find them whenever he wants.

videos.title: Deadly Lodestone
videos.overview: The Giants have invented a detector that can home in on Earth-based metals, and Dan puts the entire group at risk due to the surgical pin in his leg.

videos.title: Night of Thrombeldinbar
videos.overview: Fitzhugh pretends to be an elf to entertain two orphan children, but things turn deadly when it's revealed that traditionally the children sacrifice the elf to make a wish come true.

videos.title: Seven Little Indians
videos.overview: Kobick uses a captured Chipper as bait in a trap to capture the entire Spindrift crew.

videos.title: Target: Earth
videos.overview: Mark is roped into helping two giant scientists build a spaceship that can return them all to Earth.

videos.title: Genius at Work
videos.overview: A giant boy-genius comes up with a pill that can enlarge an Earthling to Giant-size.

videos.title: Return of Inidu
videos.overview: The Earthlings come to the aid of a giant magician.

videos.title: Rescue
videos.overview: After the Earthlings are inadvertently responsible for two children becoming trapped in a well, they volunteer their servicse to rescue them.

videos.title: Sabotage
videos.overview: The Spindrift crew must deal with the head of Police Security, who is attempting to undermine a Senator who believes in their cause and frame the Earthlings for sabotage.

videos.title: Shell Game
videos.overview: The Earthlings come to the aid of a giant deaf boy and his poverty-stricken family.

videos.title: The Chase
videos.overview: Inspector Kobick of the SID involves the Earthlings in a plan to track down counterfeiters.

videos.title: The Mechanical Man
videos.overview: The Earthlings become involved in a scientist's scheme to build an indestructible android.

videos.title: Six Hours to Live
videos.overview: The Earthlings come to the aid of a convicted criminal who has been falsely accused.

videos.title: The Inside Rail
videos.overview: Fitzhugh tries to use his gambling expertise to pick the winners at a local racetrack, but has to enter into a deal with a giant to do so.

videos.title: Deadly Pawn
videos.overview: The Earthlings must play a game of real-life chess with a demented giant industrialist.

videos.title: The Unsuspected
videos.overview: Steve is turned into a raving paranoid by exposure to mushroom spores, and cuts a deal with Inspector Kobick to betray his crewmates.

videos.title: Giants and All That Jazz
videos.overview: The Earthlings aid a giant trumpet player against crooks.

videos.title: Collector's Item
videos.overview: Valerie is forced to act as a toy ballerina in a giant's scheme to kill his rich uncle.

videos.title: Every Dog Needs a Boy
videos.overview: When Chipper is injured by a giant dog, Barry and the others must turn to a giant veterinarian and his sadistic son for assistance.

videos.title: Chamber of Fear
videos.overview: Fitzhugh is captured by the owner of a wax museum who is involved in a stolen-diamond racket.

videos.title: Comeback
videos.overview: The Spindrift come to the aid of a has-been horror actor but during his comeback movie they find themselves in danger from his enthusiastic director.

videos.title: The Clones
videos.overview: A giant scientist performs cloning experiments on the Earthlings.

videos.title: A Place Called Earth
videos.overview: Two time travellers from 5477 come to the Land of the Giants to conquer Earth.

videos.title: Land of the Lost
videos.overview: Barry and Valerie are carried off in a balloon to a distant land ruled by a malevolent dictator.

videos.title: Home Sweet Home
videos.overview: Fitzhugh and Steve accidentally return to Earth in a space-time pod but end up in 1900 and must deal with hostile villagers.

videos.title: Our Man O'Reilly
videos.overview: The Earthlings become involved with a superstitious Irish Giant who believes they're leprechauns.

videos.title: Nightmare
videos.overview: While working with a helpful Giant scientist, the Earthlings are subjected to radiation which causes strange hallucinations.

videos.title: Pay the Piper
videos.overview: An alien piper, claiming to be the Pied Piper of Hamlin, brings his act to the Land of the Giants.

videos.title: The Secret City of Limbo
videos.overview: The Earthlings become involved in the politics of a secret underground city.

videos.title: Panic
videos.overview: A friendly Giant has a teleport device that can send the Spindrift crew back to Earth, but the SID use the whole thing as a trap.

videos.title: The Deadly Dart
videos.overview: Mark is framed for the murder of two Giants and begins acting suspiciously, turning his crewmates against him.

videos.title: Doomsday
videos.overview: The Earthlings become involved in a sabotage scheme to destroy the nearby city.

videos.title: A Small War
videos.overview: A sadistic child unleashes his mechanical toys on the hapless Earthlings.

videos.title: The Marionettes
videos.overview: The Earthlings aid an injured puppeteer by pretending to be his dancing puppets, but the owner soon suspects they are involved and prepares to capture them for the reward.

videos.title: Wild Journey
videos.overview: Using a device stolen from time-travelling researchers, Steve and Dan return to the day of the Spindrift's launch and try to alter history and stop the ill-fated flight.

videos.title: Graveyard of Fools
videos.overview: The Earthlings become involved with twin brothers who are plotting to take over the planet.

awards: Nominated for 2 Primetime Emmys. 3 nominations total
